title: Adjective Declension 6: Prepositional Singular
description: The prepositional singular for hard-stem adjectives. Masculine and neuter share -ом. The feminine reuses -ой. Triggers: в, на, о / об, при + prepositional. The prepositional always sits behind a preposition.
descriptionRussian: Предложный падеж единственного числа: мужской и средний делят окончание -ом, женский повторяет -ой. Падеж всегда требует предлог: в / на / о / об / при.
intro: The last case in the singular, and the feminine form still has not changed: four cases now share it. If you have been holding this book as a grid you should be able to see how few cells are actually distinct. The masculine and neuter take their final new ending, and the second spelling rule turns up to adjust it after certain consonants.
rules: Masculine and neuter share one prepositional singular ending: -ом. Hard-stem -ый and -ое both become -ом.

Spelling rule (Rule 2): after a husher (ж, ш, ч, щ) in unstressed position, the masculine / neuter ending is written -ем not -ом. Хороший → о хорошем; свежий → о свежем. Stressed endings keep -ом: большом, чужом.
Feminine takes -ой in the prepositional, the same form as the genitive, dative, and instrumental. Four cases converge on -ой for the feminine slot.

Triggers: в + prep (location inside), на + prep (on a surface or idiomatic place), о / об + prep (topic of speech or thought), при + prep (presence or condition). The prepositional always sits behind one of these prepositions.
examples: Маша живёт в новом доме. (Masha lives in a new house.) В + prep; дом masc: новом.
Антон работает в маленькой школе. (Anton works in a small school.) В + prep; школа fem: маленькой.
Книга лежит на старом столе. (The book lies on the old table.) На + prep; стол masc: старом.
Маша думает о хорошем друге. (Masha thinks about a good friend.) О + prep; husher rule: хороший → хорошем.
Лена говорит о красивой сестре. (Lena talks about her beautiful sister.) О + prep; сестра fem: красивой.
Дети играют в большом парке. (Children play in a big park.) В + prep; stressed ending stays -ом: большом.

items.promptEnglish: Masha is proud of her smart sister.
items.hint: Recap from Lesson 5: гордиться takes which case? Сестра is fem.
items.explanation: Recap from Lesson 5. Гордиться + instr. Сестра is feminine, so the instr ending is -ой: умной. Today's drill, starting Q1.2, switches to the prepositional. Note: -ой will appear AGAIN today as the feminine prepositional ending.

items.promptEnglish: Anton works in a big city.
items.hint: В + prep. Город is masc. The masculine prep ending is brand new today.
items.explanation: В + prep triggers the prepositional. Город is masculine, so the prep ending is -ом: большом. Note большой is end-stressed, so the stressed -ом keeps the -о (Rule 2 only swaps -ом → -ем in unstressed position). Маленький (unstressed) would give о маленьком.

items.promptEnglish: The book lies on the old table.
items.hint: На + prep. Стол is masc. Same masculine prep ending as Q1.2.
items.explanation: На + prep triggers the prepositional. Стол is masculine, so the prep ending is -ом: старом. Both в + prep and на + prep mark static location; the choice between в and на depends on the noun (enclosed space vs surface or event).

items.promptEnglish: Children play in a beautiful park.
items.hint: В + prep. Парк is masc; the adjective stem ends in -в-, no spelling rule applies.
items.explanation: В + prep. Парк is masculine, so the prep ending is -ом: красивом. The stem ends in -в- (not a husher or velar), so the -ом is straight.

items.promptEnglish: Masha thinks about a good friend.
items.hint: О + prep. Хороший stem ends in -ш-: which Rule 2 form?
items.explanation: О + prep. Друг is masculine. Хороший ends in -ш- with an unstressed ending, so by Rule 2 the prepositional is хорошем (not хорошом). Pair with свежем (о свежем хлебе): same -ж-/-ш- pattern, same unstressed ending.

items.promptEnglish: Lena talks about her smart sister.
items.hint: О + prep. Сестра is fem. Same feminine ending you have used four times now.
items.explanation: О + prep. Сестра is feminine, so the prep ending is -ой: умной. -Ой closes out the feminine sequence: gen, dat, instr, prep, four cases, one form. Only the nominative (-ая) and the accusative (-ую) stand apart for the feminine.

items.promptEnglish: Masha lives in a new apartment.
items.hint: В + prepositional. Which ending do feminine adjectives take?
items.explanation: The feminine prepositional adjective ending is -ой: в новой квартире.

items.promptEnglish: Anton works in a small school.
items.hint: Школа is feminine, and в + location takes the prepositional.
items.explanation: Школа is feminine, and the feminine prepositional ending is -ой: в маленькой школе.

items.promptEnglish: Lena talks about her old friend.
items.explanation: The masculine prepositional adjective ending is -ом: о старом друге. Animacy does not matter in the prepositional.

blanks: Антон живёт в _____ квартире. (Anton lives in a small apartment.)
fillInBlank.grammarFocus: В + prep triggers the prepositional. Квартира is feminine, so the adjective takes -ой: маленькой. Same feminine -ой you have seen across gen / dat / instr / prep.

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Masha is thinking about the fresh air.
errorCorrection.explanation: О + prep triggers the prepositional, and after -ж- in unstressed position Rule 2 writes the ending -ем, not -ом: свежем. Свежом violates Rule 2 (no unstressed -о after ж, ш, ч, щ). The plain -ом survives only on other stems or under stress (о большом доме, where -ом is stressed).

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Anton works in an old school.
errorCorrection.explanation: В answering 'where' takes the prepositional, and the feminine prepositional ending is -ой: старой. Старую is the feminine ACCUSATIVE, which would follow в only for motion 'into' (Антон идёт в старую школу).

errorCorrection.translationEnglish: Lena talks about the deep lake.
errorCorrection.explanation: О + prep triggers the prepositional, and from the genitive onward the neuter shares the masculine ending: -ое becomes -ом, giving глубоком озере. Глубокое is the nominative/accusative neuter form.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Masha lives in a new house.
minimalPairs.explanation: В + prep triggers the prepositional, not the instrumental. The masculine prep ending is -ом: новом. Новым would be the instr form (Lesson 5: с новым другом).

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Anton thinks about a good friend.
minimalPairs.explanation: After -ш- in unstressed position, Rule 2 forbids -о. The prep ending is written -ем: хорошем. Хорошом violates Rule 2.

reviewVocab.definition: prepositional case (always sits behind a preposition; answers 'О ком? / О чём? / Где?')
reviewVocab.example: В предложении 'Маша живёт в новом доме' слова 'новом' и 'доме' стоят в предложном падеже.

reviewVocab.definition: location (the meaning behind в + prep and на + prep: where something is)
reviewVocab.example: В фразе 'в большом городе' конструкция в + prep выражает местонахождение.

reviewVocab.definition: topic (the meaning behind о / об + prep: what something is about)
reviewVocab.example: В фразе 'о хорошем друге' конструкция о + prep вводит тему разговора.
